description: Use this when the user asks to save a restaurant menu to their ChefBear account and you can already read its dishes, for example from a menu photo or text in the conversation. Saves the dishes you pass as a private ChefBear menu at once, without running recognition and without using the user's recognition allowance. Copy each dish name exactly as printed (name), with its price and currency when shown; add English and Chinese names and short descriptions only when you are sure of them. Returns the menuId and a private link to open it in ChefBear. Don't call it unless the user wants the menu saved; use import_menu instead when they want ChefBear itself to recognize the photos.

items.description: Every dish on the menu, in menu order.

category.description: The menu section, such as Starters or Drinks.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD, JPY or EUR.

description.description: The menu's own description of the dish, as printed.

descriptionEn.description: A short English description of the dish.

descriptionZh.description: A short Simplified Chinese description of the dish.

isSpicy.description: True only when the menu marks the dish as spicy.

isVegetarian.description: True only when the menu marks the dish as vegetarian.

name.description: The dish name exactly as printed on the menu, in the menu's own language.

nameZh.description: The dish name in Simplified Chinese.

price.description: The price as a number, without the currency symbol.

language.description: The user's language for this menu: en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, vi, ko or ja. When omitted, ChefBear uses the conversation's language if the app reports one of these, else en.

requestId.description: A new unique ID for this save, such as a UUID. Repeating it with the same menu returns the same saved menu instead of saving twice.

restaurantType.description: The kind of restaurant in one or two words, such as thai, sushi or cafe.

title.description: The restaurant's name as shown on the menu, or a short description such as "Thai lunch menu".

name: save_menu
title: Save a menu
